instruction: Repair {{entry}}, run directly with Node's TypeScript stripping. Read one JSON document from stdin: a closed object {version:1, entries:[{key:string,value:string}, ...]}. Produce {version:2, values:{...}} as one JSON line. Trim keys, reject empty or duplicate normalized keys, preserve string values, and treat __proto__ and constructor as ordinary data keys. Validate the entire input before printing anything. Unknown keys, wrong types, trailing data and malformed JSON exit 2 without stdout.
